mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PLO_NUM) AS "uv", COUNT(1) AS "pv", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "exceptionCount" FROM SYS_OPER_LOG WHERE OPER_TIME >= #{today,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 00:00:00' AND OPER_TIME <= #{today,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59'

SELECT SUBSTR(OPER_TIME, 1, 10) AS "dateStr", COUNT(DISTINCT PLO_NUM) AS "uv", COUNT(1) AS "pv" FROM SYS_OPER_LOG WHERE OPER_TIME >= #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 00:00:00' AND OPER_TIME <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59' GROUP BY SUBSTR(OPER_TIME, 1, 10) ORDER BY "dateStr"

SELECT SUBSTR(OPER_TIME, 1, 10) AS "dateStr", SUM(CASE WHEN REQUEST_METHOD = 'POST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "postCount", SUM(CASE WHEN REQUEST_METHOD = 'PUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "putCount", SUM(CASE WHEN REQUEST_METHOD = 'DELETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "deleteCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "exceptionCount", ROUND(AVG(TO_NUMBER(TAKE_TIME)), 2) AS "avgTakeTime" FROM SYS_OPER_LOG WHERE OPER_TIME >= #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 00:00:00' AND OPER_TIME <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59' GROUP BY SUBSTR(OPER_TIME, 1, 10) ORDER BY "dateStr"
